## Contribution Policy

External code and documentation contributions are not merged in this repository. Please use issues, feature requests, discussions, or private security reports instead.

Maintainer-controlled dependency automation may open pull requests when package provenance, license-review results, and required third-party notices are documented.

- [ ] This pull request is maintainer-authored or from configured maintainer-controlled dependency automation.
- [ ] Dependency updates, if any, document provenance, license-review results, and required third-party notices.
